subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Accessibility Statements and Policies
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Accessibility Statements and Policies.

hook.text: A user with a disability can't use a feature. They look for contact info or a statement of commitment. There is none.

buildup.text: An accessibility statement declares the organization's commitment, conformance level, and known limitations.

discovery.text: Good statements include the WCAG target level, contact info for issues, and a timeline for remediation.

twist.text: The statement must be honest. Claiming full compliance while known issues exist creates legal risk.

climax.text: A transparent statement listing known issues and remediation dates builds trust with users and regulators.

punchline.text: Be honest about what works and what doesn't. Transparency builds trust.

quiz.question: What should an accessibility statement include?
options: WCAG target level, contact info, and known limitations
